# Euler Problem 541 Solution in Go

I'll solve Euler Problem 541, which asks for the sum of all positive integers n ≤ 10^11 such that σ(n) = σ(n-1) + σ(n-2), where σ(n) is the sum of divisors function.

Let me break this down step by step:

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "math"
)

// Function to calculate sum of divisors
func sigma(n int64) int64 {
    if n <= 0 {
        return 0
    }
    
    var sum int64 = 0
    sqrt := int64(math.Sqrt(float64(n)))
    
    for i := int64(1); i <= sqrt; i++ {
        if n%i == 0 {
            sum += i
            if i != n/i {
                sum += n / i
            }
        }
    }
    
    return sum
}

// Function to check if n satisfies the condition σ(n) = σ(n-1) + σ(n-2)
func satisfiesCondition(n int64) bool {
    if n < 3 {
        return false
    }
    
    sigmaN := sigma(n)
    sigmaN1 := sigma(n - 1)
    sigmaN2 := sigma(n - 2)
    
    return sigmaN == sigmaN1 + sigmaN2
}
